key_insight: Megrez guides a coding agent through cumulative textbook formalization in MK set theory by combining library-aware retrieval, proof-state feedback, and integration checks.
engineering_relevance: The system offers a workflow for extending low-resource Rocq libraries while keeping proof search and code integration aligned with verified results.
method: Build a source-rebuildable knowledge graph linking declarations, compiler references, and metadata for multilingual, dependency-aware retrieval.
Run 1–5-tactic proof bursts with live feedback, a goal-local branch ledger, and structured reflection at exponential intervals.
Check statement fidelity, audit axioms, and run full builds, supported by multi-corpus access and recoverable batch execution.
evidence_signal: Deployment and evaluation on a point-set topology corpus report effective cross-chapter formalization and scalable premise retrieval, but the abstract provides no quantitative metrics.
watch_item: Generalization beyond the evaluated topology corpus remains unclear, and curated metadata may add library-maintenance work.
paper_title: Megrez: A Knowledge-Guided Agent for Formal Mathematics over MK Set Theory
